gloss: layering; wearing multiple layers of clothing

definitions.gloss: layering; wearing multiple layers of clothing
definitions.explanation: The practice of wearing several garments on top of each other, either for warmth or as a fashion style. Common in discussions about winter dressing and fashion coordination.

examples.english: Layering is the basics in winter.

examples.japanese: {重|かさ}ね{着|ぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧。
⟦おしゃれ→おしゃれ：02515_oshare⟧な{重|かさ}ね{着|ぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧コーディネート⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}します→紹介する：05641_shoukaisuru⟧。
examples.english: I'll introduce some stylish layered outfit ideas.

examples.japanese: {重|かさ}ね{着|ぎ}しすぎて⟦{動|うご}き→動く：00904_ugoku⟧にくく⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I layered so many clothes that it became hard to move.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧ (to pile up, layer) and {着|ぎ} (wearing). Also used as a verb with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: {重|かさ}ね{着|ぎ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. In fashion, layering is treated as both a practical cold-weather strategy and a style technique.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {重|かさ}ね{着|ぎ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to layer clothes
- {重|かさ}ね{着|ぎ}⟦コーデ→コーデ：17567_koode⟧: layered outfit coordination
- ⟦おしゃれ→おしゃれ：02515_oshare⟧な{重|かさ}ね{着|ぎ}: stylish layering
- {重|かさ}ね{着|ぎ}しすぎる: to over-layer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{着込|きこ}む→着込む：26962_kikomu⟧: to bundle up — verb emphasizing putting on many layers for warmth
- ⟦{厚着|あつぎ}→厚着：15266_atsugi⟧: heavy dressing — wearing thick or warm clothing; opposite of ⟦{薄着|うすぎ}→薄着：14028_usugi⟧
- ⟦{薄着|うすぎ}→薄着：14028_usugi⟧: light dressing — wearing few or thin layers of clothing
